title: q-enriched-sheaf-tensor
description: The tensor product F (x) G of two Q-enriched sheaves on a Grothendieck site - the pointwise tensor of their stalks in Q-Cat_cwl followed by sheafification, supplying the monoidal piece of the closed symmetric monoidal structure on the Q-enriched sheaf category.

left.description: the first Q-enriched sheaf factor F

right.description: the second Q-enriched sheaf factor G

pointwiseTensor.description: cell-wise (F (x)_p G)(sigma) = F(sigma) (x)_Q G(sigma), with restrictions f^tau_sigma (x) g^tau_sigma, taken in the symmetric monoidal closed category Q-Cat_cwl (Stubbe 2005)

result.description: F (x) G, the Q-enriched sheaf produced as the tensor

sheafified.description: F (x) G = sheafify_J(F (x)_p G), the universal Q-enriched sheaf receiving a Q-functor map from the pointwise presheaf; sheafification is left adjoint to Sh -> PSh

leftAdjointEachVariable.description: - (x) - is left adjoint in each variable to the internal Hom, giving the Q-enriched sheaf category a closed symmetric monoidal structure (closed-monoidal structure theorem)
